frozen_runner_defect.summary: spikes/shared/pty_driver.py create_proxy() chmods the generated proxy to 0o555 (line 176) and then the proxy_root rglob loop (lines 189-191) re-chmods every file under proxy-root — including bin/productteam — to 0o444. The proxy is therefore non-executable (0555 then 0444); any candidate seam exec (Bun.spawn / subprocess argv of bin/productteam ...) fails EACCES, so the palette/dynamic-sentinel/argv-log assertions and verify_boundary() (requires all six allowlisted argv entries in the log) cannot pass. pty_driver.py is frozen (FREEZE-SHA.txt); fixing it would invalidate the manifest and is not authorized.
frozen_runner_defect.consequence: run_all() (4 scenarios x 4 sizes, 37 actions, all observations) never produced evidence for either candidate. Evidence dir contains only textual-rich/iter-1/native-results.json; no pty-result.json, no benchmark-result.json, no measurements.json, no captured frames for either framework, and no opentui evidence dir at all. Full frozen benchmark is non-convergent before candidate interaction proof.

comparison_limits: Full frozen benchmark blocked before candidate interaction proof: spikes/shared/pty_driver.py create_proxy() makes bin/productteam non-executable (0o555 at line 176, then 0o444 for every file by the rglob chmod at lines 189-191), so all six proxy seams fail EACCES; palette/dynamic-sentinel/boundary-argv assertions and verify_boundary() cannot pass. pty_driver.py is frozen and hash-listed; no workaround authorized.

No frozen PTY scenario evidence exists for either candidate: no pty-result.json, no benchmark-result.json, no captured frames, no opentui evidence directory under the run dir; the only filed evidence is textual-rich/iter-1/native-results.json.

No measurements.json for either candidate: startup/RSS (D13), packaged/installed sizes (D14), dependency inventory (D15), LOC (D16), and p95 replay latency (D4) were never recorded by the frozen measure.py channel, so all cross-candidate material-advantage comparisons (20% latency/LOC/payload) and OpenTUI cost ratios (installed size/warm startup/streaming RSS <=1.5x Textual) are impossible.

Under score.py's citation rule (every score>0 requires evidence files under runs/tui-migration-20260812/), OpenTUI has zero admissible citations and Textual exactly one (native-results.json); even my candidate-tree citations would be rejected by the frozen scorer - reinforcing that neither candidate can pass the mandatory gate under the frozen rules.
Contract/event/non-TTY checks and direct PTY terminal-case (0/17 restored) results are context-recorded, not filed under the run dir; D11's 8.0 rests on that recorded evidence.
No relative statement about which candidate is better is possible (no preference scores per contract; static screenshot sophistication cannot decide the result - frozen-benchmark.md).

decision.rule_applied: score.py decide(): if neither candidate passes every mandatory dimension -> delete-both ('neither candidate passes every mandatory dimension')
decision.qualification: The delete-both outcome is forced by the letter of the frozen decision rules because no mandatory dimension reaches 9 for either candidate, and that is caused by the frozen-runner defect (non-executable proxy) blocking all common interaction/lifecycle proof - not by measured candidate failure. The retain-both path exists only under the exact predeclared 20-run neutral-host inconclusive test, which requires both candidates to first pass the mandatory gate; that condition is unmet. Retain-textual / retain-opentui require the corresponding candidate to pass the gate; neither does. No workaround is authorized; the frozen benchmark remains non-convergent.

score_precision_check: All scores one-decimal in [0,10]; missing-evidence dimensions scored 0 (D13 both); no dimension awarded >=9 without sufficient direct proof.
